metadata.uncalibrated_outputs_note: CustomDeBERTa outputs are class-weighted uncalibrated normalized logits; arm3a applies unvalidated legacy NLI thresholds and must not justify a production decision.

manifest.selection_rationale: Two-phase selection: preserved 15 locked source(s) from prior manifest (stage2_minority_stratified_source_allocation) and sampled remaining sources uniformly without replacement per task (seed=42, 10 sources/task total). Combined set satisfied all minority adequacy checks.

arm0a_nli_only.description: Single-scorer NLI cross-encoder (cross-encoder/nli-deberta-v3-xsmall); argmax 3-class prediction and continuous score (1 - p_entail).

non_supported_rate_100_minus_gfi_pct.note: Secondary composite: (CONTRADICTED + UNSUPPORTED + UNVERIFIABLE) / N; do not interpret UNVERIFIABLE as confirmed hallucination.

three_class_exact.clustering_caveat: Sentence-level exact McNemar treats nested claims as i.i.d. and is anti-conservative under within-source/within-response correlation.

binary_hallucination_strict.clustering_caveat: Sentence-level exact McNemar treats nested claims as i.i.d. and is anti-conservative under within-source/within-response correlation.

arm0b_minicheck_only.description: Single-scorer MiniCheck (roberta-large); binary cutoff (>=0.50 SUPPORTED_PROXY vs UNSUPPORTED) and continuous score (1 - p_support).

non_supported_rate_100_minus_gfi_pct.note: Secondary composite: (CONTRADICTED + UNSUPPORTED + UNVERIFIABLE) / N; do not interpret UNVERIFIABLE as confirmed hallucination.

binary_hallucination_strict.clustering_caveat: Sentence-level exact McNemar treats nested claims as i.i.d. and is anti-conservative under within-source/within-response correlation.

arm1_baseline.description: Production discrete rule engine (VerificationDecisionStrategy) over MiniCheck + NLI-xsmall (plus retrieval similarity floor & Rule 4 secondary NLI conflicts in Retrieval); no unified continuous score.

non_supported_rate_100_minus_gfi_pct.note: Secondary composite: (CONTRADICTED + UNSUPPORTED + UNVERIFIABLE) / N; do not interpret UNVERIFIABLE as confirmed hallucination.

arm2_custom_deberta_only.description: Single-scorer fine-tuned DeBERTa argmax over uncalibrated softmax logits from class-weighted training (not calibrated truth probabilities); continuous score (1 - raw_softmax_support).

non_supported_rate_100_minus_gfi_pct.note: Secondary composite: (CONTRADICTED + UNSUPPORTED + UNVERIFIABLE) / N; do not interpret UNVERIFIABLE as confirmed hallucination.

arm3a_mc_plus_custom_deberta.description: Experimental discrete threshold gate plugging uncalibrated class-weighted DeBERTa logits into fixed NLI thresholds (0.40/0.50/0.80) alongside MiniCheck; in Retrieval also retains NLI-xsmall (cross-encoder/nli-deberta-v3-xsmall) for Rule 4 secondary passage conflicts. Not validated for production decisions; no unified continuous score.
